title: Naming and display fixes
items: “Mute” is now “Prep Mode” — same feature, clearer name: set up and test timers without disrupting students.
The left-panel “Options” are now labeled “Display Modes.”
Fixed sound-menu names being unreadable in dark color schemes (e.g., Charcoal).
Hardened the timer clocks so a stray value can’t leave them stuck showing “NaN.”

title: Update notifications
items: LiveTimer now tells you when it's been updated. A dot appears on the Settings gear whenever there's something new, and you can read the full list of changes under Settings → About → What's New.
Notifications of important changes can interrupt with a pop-up — but never while a timer is running. The pop-up waits until your class timer stops.

title: Baseline release
items: This is the starting point for the new update-notifications system. Changes made before this release aren't listed here.
